title: Total torque | 200 ms | balanced positions | fixed training-maximum EMG scale
normalisation: One scale per muscle = maximum of the training part of the source session (positions pooled); applied unchanged to validation and to the other session.
hypothesis: Passive-table errors and session-dependent passive levels may limit the active-torque results; predicting measured total torque removes the passive table from the target. This study tests that; it is not assumed to help.
motivation: Total-torque study (exploratory). Target = processed measured total torque, no passive subtraction. Inputs: 4 EMG envelopes + ankle angle, 200 ms windows (20 samples at 100 Hz). Balanced positions exactly as D01 (train on target / training SD of its position, floor 0.1 Nm; predictions multiplied back to Nm). No auto-gain. LSTM 8x2, dropout 0.3, Nadam 0.003, batch 8, ReduceLROnPlateau 0.7/10, EarlyStopping 25 on source-session validation loss, max 200 epochs; identical in all four TT experiments.
